quotes.speaker: Jayla Forbes
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayla Forbes on developing a fourth-quarter mentality
quotes.excerpt: It really teaches you that fourth-quarter mentality and really pushing through and fighting through fatigue and mental fatigue.
quotes.quote: It really teaches you that fourth-quarter mentality and really pushing through and fighting through fatigue and mental fatigue through the entire weekend because it's hard. It's really hard.

quotes.speaker: Chloe Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Chloe Johnson on the next-play mentality in EYBL
quotes.excerpt: Any team can come back down 20 whenever.
quotes.quote: I would say you just have a next-play mentality and any team can come back down 20 whenever.

quotes.speaker: Chloe Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Chloe Johnson on Paige Bueckers as an inspiration
quotes.excerpt: Following her to now in the WNBA, that's definitely someone I've looked up to for a long time.
quotes.quote: Being from Minnesota definitely paid off. I got to see her in high school and then following her to now in the WNBA, that's definitely someone I've looked up to for a long time. I watch a lot of film on her and how she plays.

quotes.speaker: Jayla Forbes
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayla Forbes on A'ja Wilson as a role model
quotes.excerpt: You can put her in any position and she'll thrive.
quotes.quote: A'ja Wilson, that's probably a lot of people's, but she's just great. You can put her in any position and she'll thrive and her footwork is great, everything's just great, rebounding, everything. Really good role model.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Morris
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Morris on Brianna Stewart's influence on her game
quotes.excerpt: I've been told Brianna Stewart, like how I play, is just like her.
quotes.quote: I don't watch it that much, but I've been told Brianna Stewart, like how I play, is just like her.

quotes.speaker: Jayla Forbes
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayla Forbes on her aggressive post-player mentality
quotes.excerpt: I'm a post player, so you know it's always banging and aggression and who wants it more.
quotes.quote: I'd say aggressive. I'm a post player, so you know it's always banging and aggression and who wants it more and who can hit the hardest for that rebound and everything, so I feel like that's where it comes from.

quotes.speaker: Chloe Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Chloe Johnson on playing with poise
quotes.excerpt: I'd say poised. It obviously has come with a lot of training and just watching a lot of film.
quotes.quote: I'd say poised. It obviously has come with a lot of training and just watching a lot of film. I feel like that's probably been one of my biggest advantages, just kind of watching the game, so that's probably what kind of had got me to play with good pace and just kind of really understanding the game at a deeper level.

quotes.speaker: Jayla Forbes
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayla Forbes on passing as her basketball superpower
quotes.excerpt: For me, passing is one of mine.
quotes.quote: I'd say passing. For me, passing is one of mine.

quotes.speaker: Jayla Forbes
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayla Forbes on the annoyance of slow-lane drivers
quotes.excerpt: People will sit in that fast lane and go 90-20, 90-20, 90-20.
quotes.quote: I feel like for long road trips, like when you're driving six or maybe even two hours, you want to set that cruise, right? So like you set it at 75, 79, whatever and you move in and out of the lane, you know like you're supposed to. But people will sit in that fast lane and go 90-20, 90-20, 90-20. I feel like that's like my biggest pet peeve.
